arabic: بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ لَآ أُقْسِمُ بِهَٰذَا ٱلْبَلَدِ

translations.en.sahih: I swear by this city, Makkah -
translations.en.pickthall: Nay, I swear by this city -
translations.en.yusufali: I do call to witness this City;-
translations.id.indonesian: Aku benar-benar bersumpah dengan kota ini (Mekah),

translations.en.sahih: And you, [O Muhammad], are free of restriction in this city -
translations.en.pickthall: And thou art an indweller of this city -
translations.en.yusufali: And thou art a freeman of this City;-
translations.id.indonesian: dan kamu (Muhammad) bertempat di kota Mekah ini,

translations.en.sahih: And [by] the father and that which was born [of him],
translations.en.pickthall: And the begetter and that which he begat,
translations.en.yusufali: And (the mystic ties of) parent and child;-
translations.id.indonesian: dan demi bapak dan anaknya.

translations.en.sahih: We have certainly created man into hardship.
translations.en.pickthall: We verily have created man in an atmosphere:
translations.en.yusufali: Verily We have created man into toil and struggle.
translations.id.indonesian: Sesungguhnya Kami telah menciptakan manusia berada dalam susah payah.

arabic: أَيَحْسَبُ أَن لَّن يَقْدِرَ عَلَيْهِ أَحَدٌۭ

translations.en.sahih: Does he think that never will anyone overcome him?
translations.en.pickthall: Thinketh he that none hath power over him?
translations.en.yusufali: Thinketh he, that none hath power over him?
translations.id.indonesian: Apakah manusia itu menyangka bahwa sekali-kali tiada seorangpun yang berkuasa atasnya?

translations.en.sahih: He says, "I have spent wealth in abundance."
translations.en.pickthall: And he saith: I have destroyed vast wealth:
translations.en.yusufali: He may say (boastfully); Wealth have I squandered in abundance!
translations.id.indonesian: Dan mengatakan: "Aku telah menghabiskan harta yang banyak".

translations.en.sahih: Does he think that no one has seen him?
translations.en.pickthall: Thinketh he that none beholdeth him?
translations.en.yusufali: Thinketh he that none beholdeth him?
translations.id.indonesian: Apakah dia menyangka bahwa tiada seorangpun yang melihatnya?

translations.en.sahih: Have We not made for him two eyes?
translations.en.pickthall: Did We not assign unto him two eyes
translations.en.yusufali: Have We not made for him a pair of eyes?-
translations.id.indonesian: Bukankah Kami telah memberikan kepadanya dua buah mata,

translations.en.sahih: And a tongue and two lips?
translations.en.pickthall: And a tongue and two lips,
translations.en.yusufali: And a tongue, and a pair of lips?-
translations.id.indonesian: lidah dan dua buah bibir.

translations.en.sahih: And have shown him the two ways?
translations.en.pickthall: And guide him to the parting of the mountain ways?
translations.en.yusufali: And shown him the two highways?
translations.id.indonesian: Dan Kami telah menunjukkan kepadanya dua jalan,

translations.en.sahih: But he has not broken through the difficult pass.
translations.en.pickthall: But he hath not attempted the Ascent -
translations.en.yusufali: But he hath made no haste on the path that is steep.
translations.id.indonesian: Tetapi dia tiada menempuh jalan yang mendaki lagi sukar.

translations.en.sahih: And what can make you know what is [breaking through] the difficult pass?
translations.en.pickthall: Ah, what will convey unto thee what the Ascent is! -
translations.en.yusufali: And what will explain to thee the path that is steep?-
translations.id.indonesian: Tahukah kamu apakah jalan yang mendaki lagi sukar itu?

translations.en.sahih: It is the freeing of a slave
translations.en.pickthall: (It is) to free a slave,
translations.en.yusufali: (It is:) freeing the bondman;
translations.id.indonesian: (yaitu) melepaskan budak dari perbudakan,

arabic: أَوْ إِطْعَٰمٌۭ فِى يَوْمٍۢ ذِى مَسْغَبَةٍۢ
transliteration: Aw it'aamun fee yawmin zee masghabah

translations.en.sahih: Or feeding on a day of severe hunger
translations.en.pickthall: And to feed in the day of hunger.
translations.en.yusufali: Or the giving of food in a day of privation
translations.id.indonesian: atau memberi makan pada hari kelaparan,

translations.en.sahih: An orphan of near relationship
translations.en.pickthall: An orphan near of kin,
translations.en.yusufali: To the orphan with claims of relationship,
translations.id.indonesian: (kepada) anak yatim yang ada hubungan kerabat,

translations.en.sahih: Or a needy person in misery
translations.en.pickthall: Or some poor wretch in misery,
translations.en.yusufali: Or to the indigent (down) in the dust.
translations.id.indonesian: atau kepada orang miskin yang sangat fakir.

arabic: ثُمَّ كَانَ مِنَ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَتَوَاصَوْا۟ بِٱلصَّبْرِ وَتَوَاصَوْا۟ بِٱلْمَرْحَمَةِ
transliteration: Summa kaana minal lazeena aamanoo wa tawaasaw bissabri wa tawaasaw bilmarhamah

translations.en.sahih: And then being among those who believed and advised one another to patience and advised one another to compassion.
translations.en.pickthall: And to be of those who believe and exhort one another to perseverance and exhort one another to pity.
translations.en.yusufali: Then will he be of those who believe, and enjoin patience, (constancy, and self-restraint), and enjoin deeds of kindness and compassion.
translations.id.indonesian: Dan dia (tidak pula) termasuk orang-orang yang beriman dan saling berpesan untuk bersabar dan saling berpesan untuk berkasih sayang.

translations.en.sahih: Those are the companions of the right.
translations.en.pickthall: Their place will be on the right hand.
translations.en.yusufali: Such are the Companions of the Right Hand.
translations.id.indonesian: Mereka (orang-orang yang beriman dan saling berpesan itu) adalah golongan kanan.

arabic: وَٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ بِـَٔايَٰتِنَا هُمْ أَصْحَٰبُ ٱلْمَشْـَٔمَةِ
transliteration: Wallazeena kafaroo bi aayaatinaa hum as-haabul Mash'amah

translations.en.sahih: But they who disbelieved in Our signs - those are the companions of the left.
translations.en.pickthall: But those who disbelieve Our revelations, their place will be on the left hand.
translations.en.yusufali: But those who reject Our Signs, they are the (unhappy) Companions of the Left Hand.
translations.id.indonesian: Dan orang-orang yang kafir kepada ayat-ayat Kami, mereka itu adalah golongan kiri.

translations.en.sahih: Over them will be fire closed in.
translations.en.pickthall: Fire will be an awning over them.
translations.en.yusufali: On them will be Fire vaulted over (all round).
translations.id.indonesian: Mereka berada dalam neraka yang ditutup rapat.
